Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Social presentation

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

Tab opens the scoreboard with names, kills, deaths, damage, slain dwellers, gems, HP and Ping (ms). Ping is application round-trip time measured by the authority, including both processes' queues and pump cadence. The local authority reads zero; unmeasured/stale rows show --. Observers receive measurements without acquiring a player row. Departed player rows are hidden.

The game initializes the optional shared telemetry.Diagnostics runtime, which collects local diagnostic measurements, and adds its application lane when opening Solo/Session/Room. It updates diagnostics after the outer session pump and reads the result only for presentation. Measurements are not world state, saved progress or host-migration data. Fencing and authority/ connection changes invalidate them; the new authority measures again. Leaving a session clears readback before a new connection can use the same UI.

F sends a positional ping from the local player. The marker uses the name stamped by the Comms authority when it accepted the marker, falling back to Seat N for an unnamed sender. A later rename does not relabel an already-visible ping. Plain Label text preserves literal brackets/markup characters. Markers last 2.5 seconds and are removed when the room/content/authority epoch, run or floor changes. They do not reappear as historical chat or after a late join.

Enter in the name field submits the chosen name through the existing name-profile and lobby Profile action path. This works while the lobby/menu is open during play. Invalid names preserve the previous choice and keep the field editing. Typing inside the name field captures social/gameplay shortcuts, including F. A valid submission releases field focus and consumes the Enter edge so it does not also trigger chat/gameplay. It introduces no new simulation command, content revision or archive conversion.

The native and Chrome gate covers measured values, literal rename attribution, marker expiry, observer/departed rows, rejoin, and a real authority handoff with fresh measurements and early retirement of an old-epoch marker. This closes those social-presentation rows; broader private channels, director timing, visual review and full-game parity remain open.
